da...@schwartz.manawatu.gen.nz (David Schwartz) writes:

>What are the SPTR?

A variation on the DCI tournament rules. SPTR is created by the Corrupter
to fix various problems he (and others, incl. myself) has with the official
rules - notable Vote Pushing and Repat Actions, but also extending to the
redefintion of "directed" actions - eliminating the
omni-directability-granting power that the RT has given the (D) symbol.

It is available on the Corrupter's page at:

http://mrfrench.cslab.uwlax.edu:80/~sulli_al/jyhad/SPTR.html
